main.description: A Massachusetts legislature hearing mirrored into an ATProto repo. Record key convention: the upstream EventId as a string (e.g. '4837'), which consumers must treat as opaque — hearingId is carried as a field. Video transcription state (transcript ids, fetch bookkeeping) is our own pipeline's operational state, not legislative data, and is deliberately absent.

hearingId.description: Upstream EventId. Unique across general courts.

startsAt.description: Start instant, resolved from the upstream local date and time in the legislature's time zone. Unlike content.eventDate/startTime this is unambiguous.

committeeChairs.description: Names of the hosting committee's chairs, joined from the committee record at scrape time.

fetchedAt.description: When this hearing was last fetched from the upstream legislature API.

hearingContent.description: Hearing content as published by the legislature, minus EventId which is carried on the record itself.

eventDate.description: Upstream date string, preserved verbatim. Not format=datetime: the upstream API emits local times with no timezone offset. Use startsAt for an actual instant.

hearingHost.description: The hosting committee. Both fields are nullable upstream.

location.description: Every field is nullable upstream, so none is required here.

agendaDocument.description: A bill scheduled at this hearing. billNumber + generalCourtNumber is the ONLY bill<->hearing key the upstream API provides; it is deliberately a plain identifier rather than a strongRef, because the publisher has no CID for the bill record at the time it writes a hearing.
